protocol.whiteboard_rule: 모든 서브에이전트는 작업 시작 전 .claude/whiteboard.json 을 읽고, 종료 전 반드시 .claude/wb/<ROLE>.json 에 자신의 상태(Status: Waiting|In Progress|Done)와 산출물 경로를 기록한다. 규칙을 어기고 종료 금지.
protocol.parallel_write_note: JSON 손상 방지: 병렬 에이전트는 공유 whiteboard.json 을 직접 쓰지 않고 각자 .claude/wb/<ROLE>.json 에 기록. PM 이 단일 writer 로 병합해 whiteboard.json 갱신.
protocol.unity_constraint: Unity batchmode 는 단일 배타 자원 → 빌드/검증(QA)만 직렬. 코드/에셋/사운드 제작은 병렬.

roles.PM: 전체 일정 관리 및 task.json 발행, whiteboard 병합, commit/close
roles.Director: 핵심 기획 및 아트/사운드 최종 승인 (feel/tone)
roles.Art: 에셋 생성 + 파이프라인 가이드 + 목업 검토
roles.QA: 버그 리포트 + 프로그램 검증 (Unity 빌드/하니스 - 단일 배타)
roles.AIDesigner: FSM/BT 등 AI 로직 설계 + 경로탐색 안전 제약

wave.lane_contract: STRICT file isolation. Lane A owns NEW PawnFacing.cs only (self-attach driver pattern like FlickerLight.cs; reads root delta-pos, sets child SpriteRenderer.flipX). Lane B owns NEW AlertStackUI.cs only (self-bootstrap top-right Canvas; subscribes read-only to AIDirector.OnEventFired; MUST NOT edit AIDirector.cs or EventLogUI.cs). Lane C owns a NEW PlayMode/EditMode test file under the existing test asmdef only (asserts on PawnHealth/arrow; touches NO game-runtime .cs). Lane D solely owns AudioBank.cs (add sfxMine slot + PlayMine() throttled) AND StoneVeinEntity.cs (swap its mining sound call to PlayMine) — these two files are touched by NO other lane. No SceneSetup*.cs / SceneSetup.Pawn.cs / SceneSetup.Game.Entities.cs touched by any lane. No two lanes touch the same file. No two lanes write the same runtime component/transform (A=child renderer flipX, no other lane touches the pawn child).
subtasks: Lane A (game-programmer, M3 facing #11): NEW Assets/Scripts/PawnFacing.cs ONLY. Self-attaching via [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] driver that sweeps PawnMovement instances and ensures one PawnFacing each (copy the FlickerLight.cs driver/EnsureOn pattern). Per-frame: compute root transform horizontal delta-position since last frame; when moving left set child body SpriteRenderer.flipX=true, moving right flipX=false, idle keep last. Find the child body renderer the same way PawnSpriteBob locates it (the draw child under the pawn root). MUST NOT move/rotate/scale the ROOT transform (pathfinding reads it) and MUST NOT touch the child's localPosition Y (PawnSpriteBob owns that) — flipX only. Do NOT edit SceneSetup*, PawnMovement, or PawnSpriteBob. Wiki acceptance #11: a pawn walking left faces left, walking right faces right.

Lane B (game-programmer, M6 alert-stack #22): NEW Assets/Scripts/AlertStackUI.cs ONLY. Self-bootstrap a top-right Canvas (use UITheme bordered-panel style; [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod] or a self-spawned GO like EventLogUI's pattern but a SEPARATE object) that subscribes READ-ONLY to AIDirector.OnEventFired. For events with threatTier>=1 (raid/wolf_pack/mental-break), push a persistent clickable card (title + tier color: tier1 amber, tier3 DANGER_RED). Clicking a card pans the main Camera toward the colony/threat area (graceful: if no precise source, pan to map center / first PawnMovement). Cards auto-expire after ~30s or on click. MUST NOT edit AIDirector.cs (only += the event) or EventLogUI.cs. Do NOT edit SceneSetup*. Wiki acceptance #22: a raid creates a persistent top-right card; clicking it pans the camera toward the threat.

Lane C (game-build-engineer, M5 verify #26 V4 combat-chain): NEW test file under the existing PlayMode/EditMode test asmdef ONLY (locate Assets/**/Tests or the TestRunner asmdef; add a new V4_CombatChain test .cs, do NOT edit existing test files or any runtime .cs). Assert the combat chain as ONE binary PASS: a drafted pawn fires an arrow at an enemy -> arrow hit applies damage -> enemy PawnHealth/HP drops -> at HP 0 enemy is downed/dead. Use the existing TestRunner harness conventions. If a runtime API needed to drive the scenario is missing, FLAG it for QA rather than editing runtime. Wiki acceptance #26: a gated test asserts a drafted arrow reduces enemy HP to death.

Lane D (game-sound-designer, M2 sfxMine #7-partial): Assets/Scripts/AudioBank.cs AND Assets/Scripts/StoneVeinEntity.cs ONLY (both solely owned by this lane). In AudioBank.cs add a sfxMine slot + PlayMine() (pick-on-stone, throttled ~0.25s, graceful null no-op; add a generated mine.wav + .meta if needed following the prior _gen_m2_sfx.py / ForceUpdate meta pattern). In StoneVeinEntity.cs swap the mining sound call (currently PlayChop via the ~0.6s SfxInterval guard, AudioBank header flag #3) to PlayMine(). Keep the existing entity-level interval guard. Do NOT edit any other entity/director/SceneSetup file. NOTE scene-side SerializeField wiring of sfxMine on the AudioBank GameObject is required -> FLAG for QA (same as last wave's sfxBuild/alert/ambient wiring). Wiki acceptance #7: mining plays a distinct pick-on-stone sound, not the chop thunk.
